summary: Verified and triaged 2 security findings from identified hypotheses and systemic risks.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Access to Sensitive Data
findings.description: CONFIRMED: An attacker may be able to access sensitive data without proper authentication.
findings.mitigation: Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms to restrict access to sensitive data.

findings.title: Insufficient Input Validation
findings.description: CONFIRMED: An attacker may be able to inject malicious input, potentially leading to security vulnerabilities.
findings.mitigation: Implement robust input validation and sanitization mechanisms to prevent malicious input.
